text:
zoe_ae: Quick heads-up: MeridianTech is asking for a 2-week POC. Requirements: BYO HSM with non-exportable keys, 14-day rotation, signed rotation chain, and audit trail ingest into their SIEM. They want low-latency remote-sign (~250 rps bursts). Need quick feasibility + minimal SOW. cc @ashish_se @mira_security

ashish_se: Feasible. Need vendor PKCS#11 module or KMIP creds, and whether they want proxy-mediated signing or direct peering from our nodes. Also ask if rotation must be orchestrated by them or automated by us. Network model affects latency.

zoe_ae: Customer prefers proxy + mTLS to their HSMs (no inbound from their colo). Rotation: customer will trigger rotation but wants us to capture signed proof and store immutable proof refs.

mira_security: Security checklist: FIPS cert, attestation of HSM model, proof that keys never leave HSM, tamper-evident logs, and sample rotation proof format. For POC notarized attestation not required, internal attestation + logs OK. Blocker: we must ensure we never retain key material in logs or backups.

sam_sre: For 250 rps bursts we'll likely need 2 proxy nodes in staging to simulate. We'll run load tests and produce latency percentiles. For rotation proof we can produce signed audit entries and push a digest to their SIEM endpoint (or provide webhook).

zoe_ae: Procurement question: pricing — they want a predictable monthly fee, balk at per-sign surcharges. Suggestion?

sam_sre: Offer: small POC flat fee covering onboarding + 2 dry runs; production: reserved throughput tier (monthly) + optional overage. Can include SIEM integration as add-on.

ashish_se: Tech note: provide sample curl for POC to show flow:

```
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.local/sign -H 'Authorization: Bearer POCTOKEN' -d '{"key_id":"meridian-1","payload":"...base64..."}'
```

Proxy -> mTLS -> customer HSM; response is signature blob. We'll capture timing and audit trace id.

ops_bot: deploy: staging-proxy rolled out to staging-us-west at 2026-07-12T09:12Z

mira_security: I'll draft the runbook snippet and QA answers: required artifacts = HSM certs, vendor module, IP allowlist, SIEM webhook details, custodian contact. Also note: CI check to block accidental key material in logs.

zoe_ae: I'll ask Meridian for vendor .so, IP ranges, and custodian contacts. Customer agreed to manual rotation for the POC as long as we provide signed proofs.

sam_sre: Next steps: 1) get vendor module + allowlist, 2) schedule dry-run, 3) run perf and produce SOW. I'll size nodes after we see PKCS#11 perf.

zoe_ae: Great, thanks team — I'll update after vendor files arrive. :pray:
